what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Uganda, as recorded by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 2000 people displaced by conflict and violence, while UNHCR's file shows no figure above zero.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uganda from 2003 to 2011 and from 2013 to 2017, with the LRA and ADF as opponents.
IDMC's disaster records for Uganda list floods, storms, mass movements and wildfires.

when.text: IDMC's figures fell from 435000 in 2009 to 2000 in 2025.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2009.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 1978 new displacements by conflict and violence and 29474 by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Uganda.
